Title: Software Engineer I (Entry Level) – Java
Location: Remote
Clearance: Active DoD Secret
Employment Type: Full-time, W-2 

About the Role

VivSoft is seeking an entry-level Software Engineer to support the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency's (DCSA) personnel vetting modernization. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and a named mentor, you will deliver features across the Defense Information System for Security (DISS) and its modernized replacement, the Personnel Vetting Adjudication and Access Management System (PVAAMS), running in AWS GovCloud.

Java is the primary programming language on this program. This is a mentored role on a mission-critical federal program – a strong first or second job for a cleared engineer who wants real production work rather than a sandbox, and who is curious about the mission, not just the stack.

Key Responsibilities
Pick up assigned user stories against the DISS and PVAAMS backlogs and close them with guidance from senior engineers.
Write Java code and unit tests for every change as part of the definition of done.
Work inside the program's CI/CD pipeline and resolve findings raised by automated quality and security gates with support from senior engineers.
Resolve assigned defects and support regression testing.
Participate in Agile ceremonies: standup, sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives.
Maintain code and configuration documentation for the work you deliver.
Build fluency in the DCSA personnel-security domain over your first six months.

Required Qualifications
0–2 years of professional software development experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field – or equivalent demonstrated coding ability (e.g., bootcamp plus a real portfolio, or military technical experience).
Java as your primary programming language: solid working knowledge of core Java (OOP, collections, exceptions, streams) through coursework, internships, or professional work.
Exposure to Spring Boot or a similar Java framework for building REST APIs.
Unit testing with JUnit (Mockito a plus) – you write tests as a habit, not an afterthought.
Familiarity with Maven or Gradle and basic SQL.
Working knowledge of at least one front-end framework (Angular or React) with JavaScript/TypeScript.
Git-based source control and comfort working inside a CI/CD pipeline.
Basic cloud literacy; AWS preferred.
Active DoD Secret clearance (T3/T3R) or higher; must be enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting (CE/CV) prior to start.
U.S. person.
Ability to work on-site in the National Capital Region 2–4 days per week.

Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to AWS GovCloud, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), or infrastructure-as-code.
Internship or co-op in a cleared or federal environment.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
Prior DCSA, NBIS, or personnel-security domain exposure.
Section 508 / accessibility awareness.
Current DCSA badge or active CAC.
About VivSoft

VivSoft solves complex federal problems with emerging and open technologies. We build secure software factories based on DoD reference designs and NIST frameworks, delivering AI/ML, data science, and microservices for DoD, healthcare, and civilian agencies.

VivSoft is an EO employer,  Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories.
